title: Complex covariance
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$ and complex-valued functions $f,g$ on $\Omega$, their complex covariance is the complex uniform inner product of the centered functions $x\mapsto f(x)-\mathbb{E}_{\Omega}f$ and $x\mapsto g(x)-\mathbb{E}_{\Omega}g$, where $\mathbb{E}_{\Omega}$ denotes uniform averaging on $\Omega$.
